heroHeadline: Uzbekistan Joins NDB as BRICS Signals Pause on Further Expansion
heroSubtitle: President Mirziyoyev ratified Uzbekistan's NDB accession on May 22, making it the first Central Asian state in the bank and the latest non-BRICS member to join — demonstrating the NDB's evolution beyond its BRICS parent structure. Russia's Lavrov simultaneously signaled at the May 15 New Delhi press conference that BRICS would 'not rush further expansion,' citing the need to streamline work after doubling membership in 2023-25. Turkey's full membership bid remains blocked by India. The NDB received an AAA rating from China Chengxin International (April 20) and is nearing Indian rupee bond issuance. India's 2026 chairmanship advances toward the September 12-13 New Delhi summit under the shadow of the FM Meeting breakdown over the Iran-UAE confrontation.
footerNote: Data sourced from official BRICS declarations, NDB annual reports, IMF, and major international outlets. Source tiers reflect editorial confidence levels.
